limitations: All six lessons and all 70 complete question records independently fully read, including every option, explanation, worked example and answer key. Targeted primary-source checks complement mathematical review; not an exhaustive sentence-to-source mapping.

Root harness independently inspected and rerun after corrections: all 10 lesson Python fences and all 3 quiz Python fences executed, 7,187 assertions passed. Verifier added 27,433 assertions including exact percentile boundary ranks, merge bounds, split-count variance and high-precision Poisson threshold. Finite tests do not prove general theorems.

Five author omissions retained visibly: exact historical attribution, unsupported population-wide natural-frequency reasoning claim, unrecorded fullest-bucket simulation measurement, claimed19% repeated-look simulation, and hardware-fault comparison. No fabricated empirical replacements.

No production latency, availability, hardware-fault, hash-flooding or human-subject experiment was performed. Model probabilities are not measured operational guarantees. Rust/Go/Java/PHP implementation statements checked in primary documentation; no corresponding runtime integration tests.

Google archive and ACM full-text retrieval failed for The Tail at Scale; original author-hosted PDF retrieved successfully. Full textbook and every further-reading page were not read. Prior global link check remains reachability evidence only.

Nearest-rank lesson code used p/100*n floating arithmetic, which selected rank8 for p7 over100 samples. Exact decimal Fraction rank fixes that boundary defect; quiz code remains a scoped example whose stated p90 data executes correctly.
